items.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
items.summary: Shravya Shetty, Distinguished Engineer, and Luke Barrington, Product Director, Google Research In a new technical report, we demonstrate how combining domain-specific foundation models, spatial tools, and upfront planning enables a Geospatial Reasoning agent to carry out complex spatial analysis and planetary prediction that standalone LLMs can’t.

items.title: First Principles First: Need to Calibrate Data Access for Disaster Resilience
items.summary: Every year on October 13, the United Nations marks the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction, a date the General Assembly fixed in 2009 after first setting aside a day for natural disaster reduction in 1989.

items.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
items.summary: Summary: As part of our work experimenting with how Claude can help accelerate drug discovery, we asked an internal research model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.

items.title: Policy
items.summary: To evaluate the safety of our systems, Anthropic is giving employee-like access to a team from METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models, and we're in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.

items.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
items.summary: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.
